reason: My ERP already flags late POs and my open-PO tracker in Excel catches the rest if my buyers keep it current. The real problem is discipline, and I don't see why I'd pay $2,000 a month to get that from a startup's tool.
objection: A tool that reads exports and forwarded emails will miss things or flood me with false alarms, and my buyers will end up checking its list on top of their own work. I've seen that kind of tool before.
would_change_my_mind: A free six-week test that catches at least one shortage my team had not already spotted, with no IT project and no changes to how my buyers work.
